{{Quote|This fleet is all that remains of the Galactic Alliance. We can't risk it -- or you.|Captain Jaius Yorub, to Admiral Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
The '''Core Fleet''', also known as the '''Core Forces''', '''Galactic Alliance Remnant Fleet''', or commonly the '''Galactic Alliance Fleet''', was a major [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]] that was formed to protect the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], part of this force escaped the ambush at the climactic [[Battle of Caamas]], and became the basis for Stazi's [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. Because of this, the GA remnant was sometimes referred to as the Core Forces, in reference to the fleet that helped to create it.

==Starships==
===Capital Ships===
During its history, the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet was equipped with various classes of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="Legacy 20" /> Most notably were the [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class main battle cruisers]],<ref name="Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="LECG" /> and one [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Legacy 21" />

===Starfighters===
The [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]] served as the Galactic Alliance's primary [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy 20" />

===Smaller crafts===
The Core Fleet maintained an assortment of smaller crafts such as [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]]<ref name="Legacy 47" /> and [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]].<ref name="Legacy 20" /> Examples of corvettes used were the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].<ref name="Legacy 47" /> Examples of Frigates used were the [[ShaShore-class frigate|''ShaShore''-class]],<ref name="LECG" /> [[Tri-Scythe-class frigate|''Tri-Scythe''-class]]<ref name="Legacy 21" /> and [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]]<ref name="Legacy 47" />

===Other vessels===
The Core Fleet also used [[Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel|''Sabertooth''-class assault/rescue vessels]],<ref name="LECG" /> a [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]],<ref name="Legacy 20" /> a [[YZ-2500 heavy transport]]<ref name="LECG" /> and [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="Legacy 47" />
